action.new_text:
# Validate inputs
    for arr in [logp_with_result, logp_call_only, logp_no_call]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError("Inputs must be numpy arrays")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError("Inputs must be 2D matrices")
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError("Input matrices must not be empty")
        if not np.issubdtype(arr.dtype, np.floating):
            raise ValueError("Input matrices must have floating dtype")
        if not np.isfinite(arr).all():
            raise ValueError("Input matrices must contain finite values")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError("Input matrices must be nonpositive")
    if logp_with_result.shape != logp_call_only.shape or logp_with_result.shape != logp_no_call.shape:
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool) or not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative scalar and not a boolean")

    n_candidates, future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape

    # Compute normalized weights (procedure Step T01)
    t = np.arange(future_horizon)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    normalized_weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()

    # Compute weighted future-token loss (Step T02)
    weighted_l_plus = -np.dot(logp_with_result, normalized_weights)
    weighted_l_empty = -np.dot(logp_no_call, normalized_weights)
    weighted_l_call_only = -np.dot(logp_call_only, normalized_weights)

    # Use stronger counterfactual baseline (Step T03)
    l_minus = np.minimum(weighted_l_empty, weighted_l_call_only)

    # Compute margin and apply threshold (Step T04)
    margin = l_minus - weighted_l_plus
    keep = margin >= tau_filter

    # Preserve order (Step T05)
    return keep, margin

{"action":"edit","path":"toolformer_filter.py","old_text":"","new_text":"import numpy as np

def filter_api_calls(with_result, call_only, no_call, tau_filter):
    # Validate inputs
    if not isinstance(with_result, np.ndarray) or not isinstance(call_only, np.ndarray) or not isinstance(no_call, np.ndarray):
        raise ValueError("Inputs must be numpy arrays")
    if with_result.ndim != 2 or call_only.ndim != 2 or no_call.ndim != 2:
        raise ValueError("Inputs must be 2D matrices")
    if with_result.shape != call_only.shape or with_result.shape != no_call.shape:
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")
    if not np.issubdtype(with_result.dtype, np.floating) or not np.issubdtype(call_only.dtype, np.floating) or not np.issubdtype(no_call.dtype, np.floating):
        raise ValueError("Input matrices must have floating dtype")
    if not np.isfinite(with_result).all() or not np.isfinite(call_only).all() or not np.isfinite(no_call).all():
        raise ValueError("Input matrices must contain finite values")
    if np.any(with_result > 0) or np.any(call_only > 0) or np.any(no_call > 0):
        raise ValueError("Input matrices must be nonpositive")
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool) or not np.isscalar(tau_filter) or not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative scalar and not a boolean")
    
    n_candidates, future_horizon = with_result.shape
    
    # Compute normalized weights
    t = np.arange(future_horizon)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    weight_sum = raw_weights.sum()
    normalized_weights = raw_weights / weight_sum
    
    # Compute weighted losses
    weighted_l_plus = -np.dot(with_result, normalized_weights)
    weighted_l_empty = -np.dot(no_call, normalized_weights)
    weighted_l_call_only = -np.dot(call_only, normalized_weights)
    
    l_minus = np.minimum(weighted_l_empty, weighted_l_call_only)
    margin = l_minus - weighted_l_plus
    keep = margin >= tau_filter
    
    return keep, margin
"}
